science.heading: The science behind the ingredients
science.body: Independent research on the key ingredients. These studies looked at the ingredients, not the finished Founder Reset product.

items.name: Creatine
items.does: Supports strength and power during high-intensity exercise, with consistent daily use.*
items.research: The International Society of Sports Nutrition reviewed research on creatine in exercise and training. At 3 g a day without a loading phase, muscle creatine stores typically build up over around four weeks.
sources: International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand (2017)

items.name: Vitamin B12
items.does: Needed for normal energy metabolism, red blood cell formation and nervous system function.*
items.research: The NIH fact sheet covers B12 intake and absorption. Supplementing matters most when intake or absorption is low, which is more common with age and plant-based diets. Additional B12 has not been shown to improve energy or endurance when B12 status is adequate.
sources: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Vitamin B12 fact sheet

items.name: Magnesium
items.does: Supports normal muscle and nerve function and is involved in more than 300 enzyme systems, including energy metabolism.*
items.research: The NIH fact sheet notes that many US adults get less magnesium from food than recommended. It reviews nutritional roles and intake, rather than testing the finished Founder Reset product.
sources: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Magnesium fact sheet

items.name: Glycine
items.does: An amino acid studied for its role in sleep quality.*
items.research: Small studies in Japan gave volunteers 3 g of glycine before bed. Yamadera and colleagues (2007) measured self-reported sleep quality and sleep recordings in people with unsatisfactory sleep. Bannai and colleagues (2012) studied next-day fatigue and performance during partial sleep restriction. These studies were small and involved industry-affiliated researchers.
sources: Bannai et al., Frontiers in Neurology (2012)
Yamadera et al., Sleep and Biological Rhythms (2007)

items.name: L-theanine
items.does: An amino acid found in tea, studied for relaxation.*
items.research: Hidese and colleagues (2019) gave 30 healthy adults 200 mg a day of L-theanine or placebo for four weeks in a randomized crossover trial, measuring stress-related symptoms, sleep and cognitive function. The study was small and received industry support.

items.a: Founder Reset is for adults. Compare the ingredient tables above with anything you already take, and talk to a pharmacist about any overlap.
